_what: ⛔ SNG-644 (C18) — THE SEVEN SEATS, AND WHICH OF THEM SOMEBODY IS STANDING IN THE WAY OF. ✅ Erik: "Just because a seat is filled doesn't mean they keep it." ⛑ A seat HELD by the savior side cannot be finished into while its holder stands; slay, turn or break her and it opens to whoever did it.
_whyItMatters: ⚡ Both holders are EPIC and all four challengers are LEGENDARY, deliberately — the lore's "restraint is thinner, and it holds anyway". A holder is in the way; she is not stronger than the thing trying to get past her. So a held seat is where the player matters most, and defending the holder is the whole war for that axis.
_whatAHolderKnows: what she is holding back — NOT that it is a seat. The counterweights mostly do not know, and a holder is the counterweight who stands in one place.

heldSeats.holdsBy: She has buried more than she has known and did not stop attending: she refuses neither the dying nor the living.

heldSeats.ifBeaten: the challenger who beat her may finish, and a finish is a seat
